quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: GE Vernova signs agreement to supply turbines for ESB's (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GE Vernova signed an agreement with ESB (Electricity Supply Board) to supply 16 units of its 6.1 MW-158m onshore wind turbines (Cypress, split-blade) for the 96 MW Chleansaid Wind Farm in the Scottish Highlands, with a 20-year services agreement; the turbines are manufactured in Germany. It is the first use of GE Vernova's 6 MW workhorse turbine in the UK; ESB is moving the project into construction.
quarterly_data.figure: 16 turbines of 6.1 MW, 96 MW; 20-year services agreement
